title: Ledger #6 second discriminator - large-angle isotropy of DESI DR1 quasars: dipolar modulation of the degree-scale clustering amplitude along the Planck 2018 VII asymmetry axis, plus the number-count dipole

inputs.name: DESI DR1 LSS clustering catalogue, QSO NGC (data)
DESI DR1 LSS clustering catalogue, QSO SGC (data)
DESI DR1 QSO random catalogues 0-3 per cap (survey selection function)
inputs.locator: QSO_{NGC,SGC}_{0,1,2,3}_clustering.ran.fits, same DESI DR1 LSScats/v1.5 path; 50,768,005 randoms used after the 0.8<z<2.1 cut

inputs.name: Planck 2018 VII (Isotropy and Statistics of the CMB) dipolar power modulation: A ~ 0.07 at ell <~ 60 toward (l,b) = (209 deg, -15 deg)
Hirata 2009, constraints on cosmic hemispherical power anomalies from quasars (literature context only; no number of theirs is used in a lab result)
Ledger #6 first discriminator (theory-side closure of the asymmetry class: EKC route dead at |f_NL| = 2.19)
Pre-registration (statistic, nulls, decision rule, outcome meanings) fixed before any statistic was computed

environment.python: python3.12 (research/desi_png_reproduction/.venv312) + numpy 2.5.2 + scipy 1.18.1 + astropy 8.0.1 + healpy 1.20.0 + matplotlib
environment.hardware: cpu-only; Apple M-series MacBook Air (24 GB), macOS 25.5.0 arm64

original_run.wall_clock: 23.2 s map build + 5.0 s analysis + 4 s figure (measured)

reproduction.est_wall_clock: ~35 s once the DR1 QSO catalogues are on disk; ~1 h if they must be downloaded (about 18 GB)
reproduction.notes: Deterministic given seed 20260919 (Poisson null, injection-recovery). No network at run time. New bytes written: ~2.3 MB of HEALPix maps + 0.3 MB figure + JSON. The only external requirement is the DESI DR1 LSS QSO clustering catalogues and randoms 0-3 per cap; randoms 4-6 exist locally but are not used (4 files per cap already give 59x the data density).

verification: Re-run all three scripts and confirm: (a) sample sizes 555,913 (NGC) + 300,918 (SGC) data and 32,546,199 + 18,221,806 randoms after the 0.8<z<2.1 cut, masked footprint 10,660 pixels = 8946.87 deg2; (b) S2_modulation.A == -0.05347 +/- 1e-4 with A_err == 0.04275 +/- 1e-4 and a_cap == [0.004809, 0.006207] +/- 1e-5; (c) N1_poisson_null.shot_plus_clustering.p_two_sided_b == 0.186 and N2_axis_scan.p_LEE == 0.582 with n_axes_admissible == 1536 (seed-exact); (d) validation_injection: A_in 0.07 recovered as 0.0766 +/- 0.0469 (bias < 0.01), A_in 0.20 recovered as 0.1972; (e) S1_dipole.amp == 0.004464 +/- 1e-5 with N3_bracket.no_weight_sys.dipole_amp == 0.02205 (the 5x growth when WEIGHT_SYS is removed) while N3_bracket.no_weight_sys.A == -0.0546 (A moves by < 0.002); (f) decision.detection == false. Any change to (b), (c) or (f) invalidates the verdict.
